content: उद्वेग {%a.%} [उद्गतो वेगोऽस्मात्] .²1 Going swiftly (as an express messenger), courier. .²2 Steady, calm, tranquil. .²3 Ascending, mounting. .²4 One whose arms by long practice continue always raised above the head (as an ascetic). .{@-गः@} .²1 Trembling, shaking, waving. .²2 Agitation, excitement; हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः <ls>Bg. 12. 15</ls>. .²3 Alarm, fear; शान्तोद्वेगस्तिमितनयनं दृष्टभक्तिर्भवान्या <ls>Me. 38</ls>; सहसोद्वेगमियं व्रजेदिति <ls>R. 8. 7</ls>. .²4 Anxiety, regret, sorrow, distress (caused by separation from oneʼs favourite object). निवसन्त्यत्र राजेन्द्र गतोद्वेगा निरुत्सुकाः <ls>Mb. 3. 173. 14</ls>. .²5 Admiration, astonishment. .{@-गम्@} A betelnut (fruit.).
